entities.summary: Bernard Francis Dunster was a Canadian ice hockey player. He was a member of the Ottawa RCAF Flyers who won the gold medal in ice hockey for Canada at the 1948 Winter Olympics in St. Moritz. He died in Ottawa in 1995.
